# Synthetic accepted-TEI handoff fixture

This package is synthetic conformance data for PIPE-024. It contains no real
source text, OCR editor state, human review, OCD state, or publication output.

`valid/` is the portable package used by the independent OCD boundary tests.
The tests create temporary negative copies for stale bytes, missing evidence,
path escape, identity drift, scope drift, and contradictory decision claims.
